reasons: scale and relationships to retain crews
tailwind from construction labor shortage keeping pricing power with established builders
mentions.text: @funniestlines Great point. That's actually another tailwind for the builders who already have the labor locked in. The construction labor shortage limits new supply, which keeps pricing power with the established builders like DHI, Lennar, PulteGroup, Taylor Morrison, etc. who have the scale and relationships to retain crews
